info.body_text:
But as she sat down at her desk, trying to focus on her work, the naughty thoughts continued to linger in her mind. She couldn't shake off the lingering desire that had taken hold of her. With a blush creeping up her cheeks, Emilie tried to distract herself by diving into her tasks, but the memory of that forbidden moment kept replaying in her head. day at the bar.

It was hard to concentrate with the computer screen glowing in front of her, as she found herself daydreaming about her boss in a fantasy that left her breathless. The image of his strong, commanding presence lingered in her mind, causing an unexpected thrill to run through her body. Despite trying to focus on her work, Emilie couldn't help but let her imagination wander back to the past


"Emilie ? Can I have you opinion on something ?"
Emilie snapped back to reality at the sound of her boss's voice, feeling her cheeks flush with embarrassment.

"Yes, of course,"
she replied, trying to mask her distraction. As John showed her the project on his computer screen, Emilie did her best to provide feedback and input, all the while struggling to push aside the lingering thoughts of their encounter at the bar.
It was a challenge to maintain professionalism in the face of such a tempting distraction.


"We can do it like that, what do you think ?"


Tease him

Just casually end the day (Boss path end)
